info.name: CNC Program Transfer - Simple operator and device flows
info.description: Start with 1 Setup, then choose SEND or FETCH, then Check jobs / Download. User JWT and device token are deliberately separate. No credentials are included. Default URL is localhost:8000. Collection Runner stops after the current request: this is a manual integration guide, not an automated controller test. Do not run device claim/completion requests while a real device owns the queue. See ../PROGRAM_TRANSFER_QUICKSTART.md. All response examples are illustrative, not captured production data.

exec: // Stop a Runner after the manually selected request; never auto-chain device actions.

if (!/^https:\/\//.test(base) && !/^http:\/\/(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1)(:\d+)?$/.test(base)) { pm.execution.skipRequest(); throw new Error('Use HTTPS, or http://localhost:<port> for local development. Do not include /api in base_url.'); }
if (/\/api\/?$/.test(base) || /\/$/.test(base)) { pm.execution.skipRequest(); throw new Error('base_url must have no trailing slash or /api suffix.'); }

item.name: 1 Setup - user login and machine selection
01 Login

request.description: Use a company user with Program Transfer permissions. Stores access_token and refresh_token only after a successful response. Local values are private; do not export a filled environment.

exec: if (!pm.environment.get('email') || !pm.environment.get('password')) { pm.execution.skipRequest(); throw new Error('Fill email and password in your local environment.'); }
if (pm.response.code !== 200) throw new Error('Request failed; inspect the response. No IDs were captured.');
if (!b.accessToken || !b.refreshToken) throw new Error('Login did not return both tokens.');

request.description: User refresh token only. Does not refresh device credentials.

exec: if (pm.response.code !== 200) throw new Error('Request failed; inspect the response. No IDs were captured.');

originalRequest.description: User refresh token only. Does not refresh device credentials.

item.name: 03 List machines and choose machine_id

request.description: Run once, read data, set machine_id explicitly, then run again to capture its serial. Never automatically selects the first machine.

exec: if (pm.response.code !== 200) throw new Error('Request failed; inspect the response. No IDs were captured.');

request.description: Updates only program_path. Use the actual controller path. Requires machine.update. Set confirm_setup_machine_id to machine_id once; this value is consumed.

item.name: 05 Create or replace device token (optional admin setup)

request.description: CREATES a new token and immediately REVOKES the existing token for this machine. Skip if the device already works. Requires machine.update and configured program_path. Set confirm_replace_machine_id to machine_id once; copy returned token to the device securely.

exec: if (!/^[1-9][0-9]*$/.test(String(pm.environment.get('machine_id') || ''))) { pm.execution.skipRequest(); throw new Error('Set machine_id after List machines.'); }

item.name: 07 Report an actual transfer failure

request.description: For the exact claimed job only. Set failure_message to the real failure, and confirm_failed_job_id to claimed_job_id. Repeating the same DONE or FAILED result is accepted; changing a completed result is refused.

exec: if (!id || id !== String(pm.environment.get('claimed_job_id')) || String(pm.environment.get('machine_id')) !== String(pm.environment.get('claimed_machine_id')) || pm.environment.get('program_name') !== pm.environment.get('claimed_program_name')) { pm.execution.skipRequest(); throw new Error('No matching claimed job for this machine/program. Inspect Claim next job response.'); }

if (!confirmation || confirmation !== String(pm.environment.get('claimed_job_id'))) { pm.execution.skipRequest(); throw new Error('Set confirm_failed_job_id to the reviewed claimed_job_id for this one request.'); }
if (!String(pm.environment.get('failure_message') || '').trim()) { pm.execution.skipRequest(); throw new Error('Enter what actually failed.'); }
if (pm.response.code !== 200) throw new Error('Request failed; inspect the response. No IDs were captured.');

item.name: 08 Report controller file list (replaces previous list)

request.description: Replace files with the actual controller inventory. Every call replaces the entire previous list; never send this example unchanged against a real machine. Set confirm_report_machine_id to machine_id once. Maximum 5000 entries.

exec: if (!/^[1-9][0-9]*$/.test(String(pm.environment.get('machine_id') || ''))) { pm.execution.skipRequest(); throw new Error('Set machine_id after List machines.'); }

if (!confirmation || confirmation !== String(pm.environment.get('machine_id'))) { pm.execution.skipRequest(); throw new Error('Set confirm_report_machine_id to the reviewed machine_id for this one request.'); }

if (!pm.environment.get('device_serial') || pm.environment.get('device_serial') !== pm.environment.get('machine_serial')) { pm.execution.skipRequest(); throw new Error('Run Ping to verify the selected machine.'); }
if (pm.response.code !== 200) throw new Error('Request failed; inspect the response. No IDs were captured.');
